appearances.whereabouts: traveling through Cairhien with companions, passing through mountains (Kinslayer's Dagger) and then hill country; discovers an excavation site with a giant crystal sphere; arrives at the village of Tremonsien
appearances.notable_actions: keeps group moving through the night; refuses to let Selene see the Horn again; investigates the excavation; experiences involuntary contact with saidin and the void while viewing the crystal sphere; recites a verse while entranced; nearly rides Red over the cliff edge; arrives at the Nine Rings inn
appearances.demeanor: determined, conflicted, frightened by his loss of control over the void and saidin; curious about the excavation; apologetic to Selene

appearances.whereabouts: traveling with Rand's group through Cairhien; at excavation site; arriving at Tremonsien
appearances.notable_actions: demands to see the Horn of Valere; becomes angry when Rand asks if she is Aes Sedai; regains temper and chats with Loial and Hurin; becomes frightened at excavation and urges Rand to leave; reluctantly agrees to go to village inn; offers to stay with Rand forever if he takes the Horn and rides away with her immediately; turns her back on him when he refuses
appearances.demeanor: demanding and imperious, then cold and angry, then warmer but still distant with Rand; genuinely frightened at the excavation; desperate and pleading when asking Rand to ride away with her

appearances.whereabouts: traveling through Cairhien with Rand's group; walks ahead of his horse carrying the Horn chest
appearances.notable_actions: walks or trots tirelessly with the Horn chest on his horse; begins to unstrap the chest at Selene's request but stops at Rand's order; chats with Selene about books; warns Rand that farmers might want to take the Horn; describes Rand's trance at the excavation; helps cover the Horn chest with his blanket
appearances.demeanor: patient, compliant, helpful; tries to maintain peace between Rand and Selene

appearances.whereabouts: traveling with Rand's group through Cairhien to Tremonsien
appearances.notable_actions: speaks kindly with Selene after she regains her temper; warns Rand about guards at excavation approaching; suggests heading to the village
shies at Rand's shout; goes to knees when clay crumbles at cliff edge; scrambles to safety; tied to hitching post at the Nine Rings inn
